q: How does a buyer count Kuwaiti polyethylene in Scope 3?
title: Kuwaiti polyethylene in Scope 3
short: Multiply tonnes bought by a per tonne footprint for that grade, ideally from the producer, cradle to gate. Polyethylene is not a CBAM good, so this is a Scope 3 figure, not a border charge. Without producer data, use a database value for gas based ethylene and say so.
audience: Converters and packaging makers in India, Asia and Europe buying Kuwaiti polyethylene

ul: Cradle to gate CO2 per tonne for the grade.

p: Purchase invoices with tonnes per grade, and the producer named on the delivery note.
Add the power for extrusion or moulding to get a footprint per tonne of finished product.

senseible: Senseible turns supplier invoices into a Scope 3 record with the supplier, quantity and factor behind every figure, so you can see which supplier data is still missing.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
